proof_only_authorization.do_not_run_if: uniform factual accuracy is above 0.65 and both proof metrics meet their thresholds

anti_overclaim: Sentinel5 is a screen, not a paper estimate.
Five-block paired intervals are descriptive only.
The legacy 12-field accuracy cannot establish dossier use without all frozen companion metrics and no-document baselines.
Diagnostic forms cannot authorize dataset difficulty changes by themselves.
No position claim is permitted without all preregistered forms required for that claim.
